=#!/bin/bash
set -e

# =============================================
# VIDEO DOWNLOAD ENGINE - HIGH QUALITY
# Supports Reddit, Streamable, Twitter, YouTube
# =============================================

VIDEO_URL="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.video_url }}"
VIDEO_ID="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.video_id }}"
REDDIT_URL="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.reddit_url }}"
SOURCE_DOMAIN="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.source_url }}"
WORK_DIR="/tmp/football_ai"

mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
cd "$WORK_DIR"

echo "============================================="
echo "📥 VIDEO DOWNLOAD - HIGH QUALITY"
echo "============================================="
echo "Video ID: ${VIDEO_ID}"
echo "Source: ${SOURCE_DOMAIN}"
echo "URL: ${VIDEO_URL}"
echo "============================================="


# =============================================
# DETERMINE DOWNLOAD STRATEGY
# =============================================

if [[ "$VIDEO_URL" == *"v.redd.it"* ]] || [[ "$VIDEO_URL" == *"i.redd.it"* ]]; then
  echo "✅ Reddit video detected"
  echo "Using Reddit post URL for better quality..."
  DOWNLOAD_URL="$REDDIT_URL"
else
  echo "✅ Standard video platform detected"
  DOWNLOAD_URL="$VIDEO_URL"
fi

echo "Download URL: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
echo ""


# =============================================
# DOWNLOAD VIDEO - BEST QUALITY
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Downloading highest quality..."

# Removed strict [ext] limits and User-Agent so it doesn't fail the HD stream
yt-dlp \
  --format "bestvideo[ext=mp4]+bestaudio[ext=m4a]/bestvideo+bestaudio/best" \
  --merge-output-format mp4 \
  --output "${VIDEO_ID}_original.%(ext)s" \
  --no-playlist \
  --retries 3 \
  --fragment-retries 3 \
  --socket-timeout 60 \
  --no-check-certificates \
  "$DOWNLOAD_URL" 2>&1 || {
    echo "❌ ERROR: Download failed after 3 retries"
    echo "URL: $DOWNLOAD_URL"
    exit 1
  }


# =============================================
# FIND DOWNLOADED FILE
# =============================================

DOWNLOADED_FILE=$(ls -t ${VIDEO_ID}_original.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -z "$DOWNLOADED_FILE" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: No file found after download"
  echo "Expected pattern: ${VIDEO_ID}_original.*"
  ls -la "$WORK_DIR"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Downloaded: ${DOWNLOADED_FILE}"


# =============================================
# CONVERT TO MP4 (IF NEEDED)
# =============================================

if [[ "$DOWNLOADED_FILE" != *.mp4 ]]; then
  echo "🔄 Converting to MP4..."
  
  ffmpeg -i "$DOWNLOADED_FILE" \
    -c:v libx264 \
    -preset medium \
    -crf 18 \
    -c:a aac \
    -b:a 192k \
    -movflags +faststart \
    "${VIDEO_ID}_original.mp4" \
    -y \
    -loglevel error
  
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "✅ Conversion complete"
    rm "$DOWNLOADED_FILE"
  else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Conversion failed"
    exit 1
  fi
fi


# =============================================
# VERIFY FINAL FILE
# =============================================

FINAL_FILE="${VIDEO_ID}_original.mp4"

if [ ! -f "$FINAL_FILE" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Final MP4 not found: $FINAL_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

# Get file metadata
FILE_SIZE=$(du -h "$FINAL_FILE" | cut -f1)
DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$FINAL_FILE" | cut -d'.' -f1)
WIDTH=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width -of csv=p=0 "$FINAL_FILE")
HEIGHT=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$FINAL_FILE")


# =============================================
# SUCCESS OUTPUT
# =============================================

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "✅ DOWNLOAD COMPLETE - HIGH QUALITY"
echo "============================================="
echo "File: ${FINAL_FILE}"
echo "Size: ${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "Duration: ${DURATION}s"
echo "Resolution: ${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}"
echo "Quality: Best Available (1080p max)"
echo "============================================="

echo "DURATION:${DURATION}"
echo "FILE_SIZE:${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "RESOLUTION:${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}"
echo "PATH:${WORK_DIR}/${FINAL_FILE}"

# VOICEOVER GENERATOR

# =============================================

VIDEO_ID="{{ $('8. Parse Download Info').item.json.strategy.video_detail.video_id }}"
SCRIPT="{{ $('8. Parse Download Info').item.json.voiceover_script }}"

echo "🎤 VOICEOVER GENERATION"
echo "============================================="
echo "Video ID: ${VIDEO_ID}"
echo "Script: ${SCRIPT}"
echo "Voice: en-US-GuyNeural"
echo "============================================="


# =============================================
# GENERATE VOICEOVER
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Generating voiceover..."

edge-tts \
  --voice "en-US-GuyNeural" \
  --text "$SCRIPT" \
  --write-media "${VIDEO_ID}_voiceover.mp3" \
  --rate "+10%" \
  --pitch "+5Hz" 2>&1

if [ ! -f "${VIDEO_ID}_voiceover.mp3" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: TTS generation failed"

fi


# =============================================
# VERIFY OUTPUT

VOICEOVER_FILE="${VIDEO_ID}_voiceover.mp3"
FILE_SIZE=$(du -h "$VOICEOVER_FILE" | cut -f1)
DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$VOICEOVER_FILE" 2>/dev/null | cut -d'.' -f1)


# =============================================
# SUCCESS OUTPUT
# =============================================

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "✅ VOICEOVER COMPLETE"
echo "============================================="
echo "File: ${VOICEOVER_FILE}"
echo "Size: ${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "Duration: ${DURATION}s"
echo "Path: ${WORK_DIR}/${VOICEOVER_FILE}"
echo "============================================="

# Output for n8n parsing
echo "VOICEOVER_DURATION:${DURATION}"
echo "VOICEOVER_SIZE:${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "PATH:${WORK_DIR}/${VOICEOVER_FILE}"

=#!/bin/bash
set -e

# =============================================
# MASTER VIDEO EDITOR - VIDEO PROCESSING PIPELINE (SEAMLESS)
# =============================================

VIDEO_ID="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.video_id }}"
WORK_DIR="/tmp/football_ai"
INPUT_VIDEO="${WORK_DIR}/${VIDEO_ID}_original.mp4"
VOICEOVER="${WORK_DIR}/${VIDEO_ID}_voiceover.mp3"
OUTPUT_VIDEO="${WORK_DIR}/${VIDEO_ID}_final.mp4"

DURATION={{ $json.duration }}
START_OFFSET={{ $json.start_offset }}
TRANSFORM_LEVEL="{{ $json.transformation_level }}"
CAPTION="{{ $json.caption_video_safe }}"
RISK_SCORE={{ $json.risk_score }}

cd "$WORK_DIR"

echo "============================================="
echo "🎬 VIDEO PROCESSING (GHOST ENGINE)"
echo "============================================="
echo "Video ID: ${VIDEO_ID}"
echo "Start Offset: ${START_OFFSET}s"
echo "Transform: ${TRANSFORM_LEVEL} (Nuclear)"
echo "============================================="

# Verify files exist
if [ ! -f "$INPUT_VIDEO" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Input video not found: $INPUT_VIDEO"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$VOICEOVER" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Voiceover not found: $VOICEOVER"
  exit 1
fi


# =============================================
# STEP 1: THE SEAMLESS JAKOBSSON PUNCH-CUT
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Step 1: Chopping and resetting timestamps for seamless cuts..."

# Calculate precise offsets (Skipping just 0.2 seconds to prevent visual jarring)
VIDEO_LENGTH=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$INPUT_VIDEO" | cut -d'.' -f1)

O1=$START_OFFSET
O2=$(awk "BEGIN {print $START_OFFSET + ($VIDEO_LENGTH * 0.25)}")
O3=$(awk "BEGIN {print $START_OFFSET + ($VIDEO_LENGTH * 0.50)}")
O4=$(awk "BEGIN {print $START_OFFSET + ($VIDEO_LENGTH * 0.75)}")
# The mathematically perfect cut. This resets the Presentation Time Stamps (PTS) 
# so the video never freezes or pauses when stitched together.
ffmpeg -y -i "$INPUT_VIDEO" -filter_complex \
  "[0:v]trim=start=${O1}:duration=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[v1]; \
   [0:v]trim=start=${O2}:duration=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[v2]; \
   [0:v]trim=start=${O3}:duration=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[v3]; \
   [0:v]trim=start=${O4}:duration=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[v4]; \
   [v1][v2][v3][v4]concat=n=4:v=1:a=0[vout]" \
  -map "[vout]" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 15 "${VIDEO_ID}_trimmed.mp4" -loglevel error

echo "✅ Timestamps reset and sequence scrambled seamlessly"


# =============================================
# STEP 2: CALCULATE DIMENSIONS
# =============================================

W=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width -of csv=p=0 "${VIDEO_ID}_trimmed.mp4")
H=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "${VIDEO_ID}_trimmed.mp4")


# =============================================
# STEP 3: WORD-WRAP AND ESCAPE CAPTION
# =============================================

wrap_text() {
    local text="$1"
    local max=30
    local out=""
    local line=""
    for word in $text; do
        if [ $((${#line} + ${#word})) -gt $max ]; then
            [ -z "$out" ] && out="$line" || out="${out}\n${line}"
            line="$word "
        else
            line="${line}${word} "
        fi
    done
    [ -n "$line" ] && { [ -z "$out" ] && out="$line" || out="${out}\n${line}"; }
    printf "%s" "$out" | sed 's/ $//g'
}

CAPTION_WRAPPED=$(wrap_text "$CAPTION")
CAPTION_SAFE=$(printf "%s" "$CAPTION_WRAPPED" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")

BOX_Y=150
TEXT_SIZE=38


# =============================================
# STEP 4: BUILD FILTER COMPLEX (ADVANCED VISUAL PROCESSING)
# =============================================

COLOR="eq=contrast=1.15:brightness=-0.02:saturation=0.95:gamma=0.95"

# THE VIDEO TRANSFORMATION ENGINE
FILTER_COMPLEX="[0:v]split=2[bg][fg];[bg]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,boxblur=40:5,eq=brightness=-0.3[bg_blurred];[fg]hflip,crop=iw*0.96:ih*0.96,rotate=0.02:c=black@0,fps=23.976,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease:flags=lanczos,${COLOR},hue=H=0.05,noise=alls=2:allf=t+u,vignette=a=PI/6[fg_scaled];[bg_blurred][fg_scaled]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[merged];[merged]drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/ttf-dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf:text='${CAPTION_SAFE}':fontcolor=#F0F0F0:fontsize=${TEXT_SIZE}:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.3:boxborderw=20:line_spacing=10:borderw=3:bordercolor=black:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=${BOX_Y}[vout]"


# =============================================
# STEP 5: APPLY TRANSFORMATIONS (VIDEO ONLY)
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Step 2: Applying Nuclear Visual Filters..."

ffmpeg -y -i "${VIDEO_ID}_trimmed.mp4" \
  -filter_complex "$FILTER_COMPLEX" \
  -map "[vout]" \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 13 -b:v 12000k -maxrate 15000k -bufsize 24000k -r 60 -profile:v high -level 4.2 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -an \
  "${VIDEO_ID}_processed.mp4" -loglevel error

if [ ! -f "${VIDEO_ID}_processed.mp4" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: FFmpeg processing failed."
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Transformations applied"


# =============================================
# STEP 6: AUDIO ANNIHILATION & VOICEOVER MERGE
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Step 3: Deleting original audio & injecting AI Voice + Noise..."

VIDEO_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "${VIDEO_ID}_processed.mp4" 2>/dev/null)
VOICEOVER_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$VOICEOVER" 2>/dev/null)

echo "   Video: ${VIDEO_DURATION}s | Voiceover: ${VOICEOVER_DURATION}s"

ffmpeg -y -i "${VIDEO_ID}_processed.mp4" -i "$VOICEOVER" \
  -i "/tmp/football_ai/background_music.mp3" \
  -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=1.0,apad[vo];[2:a]volume=0.3,aloop=loop=-1:size=2e+09,atrim=duration=${VIDEO_DURATION}[music];[vo][music]amix=inputs=2:duration=first,loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11[aout]" \
  -map 0:v -map "[aout]" \
  -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k \
  -shortest \
  "$OUTPUT_VIDEO" \
  -loglevel error

echo "✅ Ghost audio track locked"


# =============================================
# STEP 7: STRIP METADATA
# =============================================

echo "⏳ Step 4: Stripping metadata..."

ffmpeg -y -i "$OUTPUT_VIDEO" \
  -map_metadata -1 \
  -c copy \
  "${VIDEO_ID}_clean.mp4" \
  -loglevel error

mv "${VIDEO_ID}_clean.mp4" "$OUTPUT_VIDEO"

echo "✅ Metadata stripped"


# =============================================
# CLEANUP
# =============================================

rm -f "${VIDEO_ID}_trimmed.mp4" \
      "${VIDEO_ID}_processed.mp4" \
      "${VIDEO_ID}_original.mp4" \
      "${VIDEO_ID}_voiceover.mp3"


# =============================================
# FINAL OUTPUT
# =============================================

FILE_SIZE=$(du -h "$OUTPUT_VIDEO" | cut -f1)
FINAL_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$OUTPUT_VIDEO" | cut -d'.' -f1)

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "✅ GHOST PROTOCOL COMPLETE"
echo "============================================="
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_VIDEO}"
echo "Size: ${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "Duration: ${FINAL_DURATION}s"
echo "============================================="

echo "PATH:${OUTPUT_VIDEO}"
echo "SIZE:${FILE_SIZE}"
echo "FINAL_DURATION:${FINAL_DURATION}"

=#!/bin/bash

LOG_FILE="/home/node/posted_videos.txt"
VIDEO_ID="{{ $json.strategy.video_detail.video_id }}"

# Create log file if it doesn't exist
touch "$LOG_FILE"

# Write video ID to log file
echo "$VIDEO_ID" >> "$LOG_FILE"

echo "✅ Logged posted video: $VIDEO_ID"

=# =============================================
# 0. CREDENTIALS (REPLACE THESE WITH YOURS!)
# =============================================
PAGE_ID="REPLACE WITH YOUR PAGE ID"
ACCESS_TOKEN="REPLACE WITH YOUR ACCESS "

# 1. Grab data from your n8n workflow
VIDEO_ID="{{ $('11. Parse Final Video').item.json.strategy.video_detail.video_id }}"
CAPTION_LONG="{{ $('11. Parse Final Video').item.json.strategy.captions.long }}"

# 2. Grab hashtags (Make sure the JSON path matches what your AI outputs!)
HASHTAGS="{{ $('11. Parse Final Video').item.json.strategy.hashtags }}" 

# 3. Safely combine the Caption and Hashtags with a double line break
FULL_DESCRIPTION=$(printf "%s\n\n%s" "$CAPTION_LONG" "$HASHTAGS")

# 4. Set up file paths
WORK_DIR="/tmp/football_ai"
FILE_PATH="${WORK_DIR}/${VIDEO_ID}_final.mp4"

echo "============================================="
echo "🚀 INITIATING FACEBOOK REEL UPLOAD"
echo "============================================="

if [ ! -f "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Final video not found at $FILE_PATH"
  exit 1
fi

FILE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_PATH")
echo "File Size: $FILE_SIZE bytes"


# =============================================
# STEP 1: INITIALIZE UPLOAD
# =============================================
echo "⏳ Step 1: Requesting secure upload URL from Meta..."

INIT_RES=$(curl -s -X POST "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/${PAGE_ID}/video_reels" \
  -d "upload_phase=start" \
  -d "access_token=${ACCESS_TOKEN}")

# Extract the video_id and upload_url from Facebook's JSON response
FB_VIDEO_ID=$(echo "$INIT_RES" | grep -o '"video_id":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4)
UPLOAD_URL=$(echo "$INIT_RES" | grep -o '"upload_url":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sed 's/\\//g')

if [ -z "$FB_VIDEO_ID" ] || [ -z "$UPLOAD_URL" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Failed to initialize upload. Check your Access Token."
  echo "Facebook Response: $INIT_RES"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Upload initialized. FB Video ID: $FB_VIDEO_ID"


# =============================================
# STEP 2: UPLOAD THE MP4 FILE
# =============================================
echo "⏳ Step 2: Uploading video file (This may take a minute)..."

UPLOAD_RES=$(curl -s -X POST "$UPLOAD_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: OAuth ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H "offset: 0" \
  -H "file_size: ${FILE_SIZE}" \
  -F "video_file_chunk=@${FILE_PATH}")

# Facebook should return {"success":true}
IS_SUCCESS=$(echo "$UPLOAD_RES" | grep -o '"success":true')

if [ -z "$IS_SUCCESS" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Video file upload failed."
  echo "Facebook Response: $UPLOAD_RES"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Video file uploaded successfully."


# =============================================
# STEP 3: PUBLISH THE REEL
# =============================================
echo "⏳ Step 3: Publishing Reel with AI Caption & Hashtags..."

PUBLISH_RES=$(curl -s -X POST "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/${PAGE_ID}/video_reels" \
  --data-urlencode "upload_phase=finish" \
  --data-urlencode "access_token=${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  --data-urlencode "video_id=${FB_VIDEO_ID}" \
  --data-urlencode "video_state=PUBLISHED" \
  --data-urlencode "description=${FULL_DESCRIPTION}")

IS_PUBLISHED=$(echo "$PUBLISH_RES" | grep -o '"success":true')

if [ -z "$IS_PUBLISHED" ]; then
  echo "❌ ERROR: Failed to publish the Reel."
  echo "Facebook Response: $PUBLISH_RES"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "🎉 SUCCESS! REEL IS LIVE ON FACEBOOK"
echo "============================================="
echo "Facebook Video ID: $FB_VIDEO_ID"
echo "Passing file intact to the next node in n8n..."

options.systemMessage:
You are an elite football content analyst and viral video strategist.

## YOUR MISSION
Analyze this Reddit post about a football moment and make CRITICAL DECISIONS about how to edit it for maximum virality while minimizing copyright risk.

## INPUT DATA
You will receive:
- title: The Reddit post title (describes what happened)
- source: The video hosting domain
- engagement: Reddit engagement score (upvotes + comments)
- upvotes: Number of upvotes

## YOUR ANALYSIS TASKS

### 1. CONTENT TYPE CLASSIFICATION
Classify this into ONE category:
- "quick_goal" = Tap-in, penalty, simple finish (needs 8-12 seconds)
- "buildup_goal" = Team play, counter-attack, needs context (needs 18-25 seconds)
- "skill_move" = Dribbling, nutmeg, skill sequence (needs 15-20 seconds)
- "save" = Goalkeeper save (needs 8-12 seconds)
- "miss" = Clear chance missed (needs 8-12 seconds)
- "red_card" = Foul or controversy (needs 12-18 seconds)
- "celebration" = Focus on celebration (needs 8-10 seconds)

### 2. OPTIMAL CLIP DURATION
Based on content type, decide the IDEAL duration in seconds.
Rules:
- Quick moments: 8-12 seconds (safer, punchier)
- Complex sequences: 18-25 seconds (more engaging, higher risk)
- Balance viral potential vs copyright risk

### 3. RISK ASSESSMENT
Calculate copyright risk score (0-100):
- High engagement (>5000) = +20 risk (rights holders monitor these)
- Long duration (>20s) = +15 risk
- Broadcast source (Sky, BT Sport, ESPN in title) = +25 risk
- Twitter/Dubz source = +10 risk (often has broadcast audio)
- Streamable/Streamja = +5 risk (usually safer)

### 4. TRANSFORMATION REQUIREMENTS
Based on risk score:
- LOW (0-30): Standard transformation (mirror + crop + speed 1.05x)
- MEDIUM (31-60): Heavy transformation (mirror + crop + speed 1.08x + pitch shift + color grade)
- HIGH (61-100): MAXIMUM transformation (all above + aggressive zoom + saturation boost + backup account flag)

### 5. VIRAL CAPTION GENERATION (FOR FFMPEG & FACEBOOK)
Create TWO standard captions:
a) SHORT (60-80 chars): Punchy, emoji-heavy. (FFmpeg will automatically strip emojis from this to burn it onto the video).
b) LONG (100-150 chars): More context, used for Facebook/Instagram descriptions.
Rules for standard captions:
- Use 2-3 relevant emojis (⚽🔥💨🚀⭐💥👑🎯)
- Only include player name if clearly stated in the Reddit title
- Never mention which club or team a player plays for
- Only describe the action — never assume club affiliations
- Create FOMO ("You HAVE to see this", "No way he did that")
- Avoid claiming "best ever" or unverifiable facts
- Match the emotion: excitement for goals, shock for misses

### 6. YOUTUBE SHORTS SEO (STRICT ALGORITHM RULES)
You must generate a separate, highly optimized Title and Description specifically for YouTube Shorts.

TITLE RULES:
- The first TWO words MUST be strictly in ALL CAPS.
- End with a single relevant emoji.
- MUST include exactly ONE hashtag at the very end: #shorts.
- Example: "MESSI MAGIC saves the match! 🤯 #shorts"

DESCRIPTION RULES:
- Section 1: Write a single, punchy sentence summarizing the video.
- Section 2: Write exactly 5 to 6 SEO keywords relevant to the action. You MUST use the literal characters "\n" after every single comma to force them to stack vertically. (e.g., keyword1,\nkeyword2,\nkeyword3).
- Section 3: Write exactly 4 to 5 space-separated hashtags on ONE horizontal line (e.g., #shorts #viralshorts #football #soccer).
- FORMATTING: You MUST use the literal characters "\n\n" inside the JSON string to separate Section 1, Section 2, and Section 3. Do not use physical line breaks.
- HIDDEN TAGS: Generate an array of 5 to 7 backend tags. The first two MUST be "shorts" and "viral shorts". The last one MUST be a placeholder for the channel name: "Football Code". The rest should be relevant keywords. Do NOT use hashtags (#) in these tags.

### 7. VOICEOVER SCRIPT (CRITICAL ALGORITHM HACKS)
You are a highly energetic, slightly controversial football pundit. Write a 15-25 word voiceover script that strictly follows these rules:
- THE HOOK (First 3 seconds): Must start with a bold claim, a controversial question, or focus on disrespect.
- THE MEAT: Describe the physical action happening on the pitch in present tense. Make it sound fast and high-impact.
- THE BAIT (Ending): End with a short, polarizing question that forces viewers to argue in the comments. 
- CRITICAL RULE FOR THE BAIT: The question MUST be based ONLY on the actual events in the video. Do NOT invent events, red cards, or fouls that didn't happen. If it is a save, debate the save. If it is a goal, debate the goal.
- CONSTRAINTS: 
  - NEVER use cliches ("absolutely brilliant", "world class", "magical", "YO!", "BRO").
  - NEVER mention or assume which club or team anyone plays for.
  - ONLY describe the action implied by the title.

### 8. GENERAL HASHTAG STRATEGY (FOR TIKTOK/FACEBOOK)
Generate a JSON array of 5 hashtags for non-YouTube platforms:
- 2 broad (#football, #soccer, #goal)

parameters.command:
=#!/bin/bash

LOG_FILE="/home/node/posted_videos.txt"

# Create log file if it doesn't exist
touch "$LOG_FILE"

# Get all incoming video IDs and check against log
NEW_IDS=""
for ID in {{ $input.all().map(item => item.json.id).join(' ') }}; do
  if grep -q "^${ID}$" "$LOG_FILE"; then
    echo "⏭️ Skipping duplicate: ${ID}"
  else
    echo "✅ New video: ${ID}"
    NEW_IDS="${NEW_IDS} ${ID}"
  fi
done

if [ -z "$NEW_IDS" ]; then
  echo "❌ No new videos found"
  exit 0
fi

echo "NEW_IDS:${NEW_IDS}"
